name: token-dragon
description: A pixel dragon above the prompt that grows one segment per 2% of the 5-hour rate-limit window, changes colour each window, breathes fire, and turns to bones at 100%

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: How the dragon is drawn on the terminal: auto picks an inline image on terminals known to draw one (iTerm2 3.5+, kitty, Ghostty, Orca with kitty images) and plain colored half-block text elsewhere; image or blocks forces one
